_purpose: The registry of every GENERATED data artifact + its ONE pure generator (Phase C / blueprint D2). The derived_artifacts_fresh invariant iterates this list: for each entry it re-runs the generator over the sealed pillars and compares to the on-disk artifact, so a hand-edit or a stale build of any listed artifact is un-shippable (R1). eden/tools/build_embeds.py iterates the same list to regenerate. GROWS as Phase C folds each embed into the pipeline (C3: the product embeds).
_contract: Each generator module exposes build_fn() -> the artifact object (pure, no write; used by the freshness gate) and write_fn() -> regenerates the on-disk file via safe_write (used by build_embeds). compare='json' means the gate compares json.loads(disk) == build_fn(); 'text' means exact-text. inputs list the pillar paths the generator reads (documentation + future input-hash tracking).

artifacts.note: The trace/rare-mineral coverage metric (state/coverage.ts esbuild JSON import): goal (Wallach colloidal-mineral dose expressed in mg via composition; cites WAL-CLM-EPIGEN-000089) + per-product plant-derived-mineral vehicle mg. DERIVES from the sealed Products pillar (composition mg) + the curated trace-mineral-vehicles.json (judgment: group/mode/factors/goal-model) + the sealed dose claim (goal). The 33 trace_pdm minerals are scored as ONE group (Sigma regimen pdm_mg / goal.maintenance_mg). build_data() hard-fails via validate() on a missing product or a zero-mg amount-mode product (a silently-missed vehicle pattern). §00.A: composition feeds the math; the goal is a Wallach dose, not a Youngevity target (source-rule review 2026-07-12). Deterministic (sorted keys, NO timestamp) so build_fn byte-compares to disk.

Composition only (SS00.A): an amount is what a product CONTAINS, never a Wallach target. The RAW highest-first (amount desc) data foundation for the Phase-G cost-per-nutrient recommender (saturating adequacy + breadth + banded cost; memory cost-per-nutrient-match-score). Deterministic (NO timestamp; amounts 4dp) so build_fn byte-compares to disk. Lives in eden/derived (not shipped to a view yet); promote to assets/data when a surface consumes it.

The full per-product DISPLAY record (whole label structure + an indicative YGY listing price {retail,wholesale} joined by ygy_id) read by the Knowledge Products surface (views/knowledge-products.ts): the Products list, the product detail panel, and the essentials FOUND-IN-VAULT chips. DISPLAY ONLY (§00.A) -- composition is what a product CONTAINS + price is a volatile YGY listing; neither feeds coverage. Distinct from the slim regimen-label-lookup vault (regimen/coverage path). Per-essential RANKING INPUTS for the cost-per-nutrient recommender (A3, 2026-07-08), read by state/recommender.ts (esbuild JSON import) + surfaced on the Knowledge Essentials deep-dive 'BEST SOURCES'. Each candidate carries amount (composition, canonical unit -- what the product CONTAINS), breadth (distinct essentials the product delivers), price (retail, the cost tuner). GENERATED by recommender_derive, which re-derives the composition rollup in-memory (products_composition_derive.build_data over products.json + nutrients.json + essentials-canon) + joins retail price from prices.json. §00.A: composition + price are recommender/display data, NEVER a Wallach target -- there is NO Wallach number here; the saturating-adequacy term (min(1, delivered/target)) awaits corpus dose-mining (blueprint b), until then the runtime ranks by amount-potency + breadth + value. Deterministic (NO timestamp; candidates sorted amount-desc, product_id-asc) so build_fn byte-compares to disk.

The Search 'Ask-Wallach' index (state/search.ts esbuild JSON import). DERIVES from the two hand-authored SOURCE files -- search-enrichment.json (per-claim subject/facet/question/answer_short/also_about/topics) + the entity registry search-entities.json -- JOINED with the sealed claim (answer = claim_text minus the ' In his words:' tail, byte-faithful; verbatim; page; book_id; tier1_link from the claim's essentials/conditions/symptoms arrays) + books-meta (composed cite) + essentials-canon (canon entity display_name/symbol, so a canonical name is never hand-duplicated). build_index() hard-fails via validate() on a bad facet / subject not in registry-or-canon / unresolved also_about / missing authored field / empty derived answer-or-verbatim (validate() is shared with the search_index_wellformed invariant). Replaces the retired thin-slice drafts (mercury-slice.json + the hand search-entities.json under assets/data/search). Deterministic (sorted) so build_fn byte-compares to disk. G-7 entity-by-entity build: mercury (13) + calcium (8) are the first two entities.

GENERATED per-entity page view-model (Phase H0) for every essential + condition. LEAN: each record carries claim IDs + derived extras (co-occurrence related[], per-condition protocol_claim_ids, a derived one_liner, synonyms) but NOT claim text -- text/verbatim/citation resolve at render from corpus-embed + search-index (already loaded), so nothing is duplicated. Targets, live coverage %, and best-sources ranking stay in their own homes; this artifact does not carry them. Claims grouped by raw KIND (stable projection); the kind->colour category grouping + the essentials[]-union works-with/restore pills + hero prominence are DEFERRED to H1. Loose file in H0 (no view imports it yet -> zero bundle impact until H2). Deterministic (fixed ordering, no timestamp) so build_data() byte-compares to disk.

_accounted_purpose: The COMPLETENESS half of R1 (crack #1 fix, 2026-07-06). derived_artifacts_fresh proves the `artifacts` above are fresh; it does NOT prove the list is complete. The data_artifacts_accounted invariant requires EVERY dashboard/assets/data/*.json to appear either in `artifacts` (derived + freshness-gated) or here in `accounted` (hand-authored or gated by a dedicated invariant), each with a disposition + reason. A data file in neither list is RED -- no silently-added hand-maintained artifact can ship. disposition = hand_authored | externally_gated.
